tabs.label: History
paragraphs: Founded by Juan Ludeña, we began as a modest, family-operated venture fueled by a grand vision: to deliver unparalleled HVAC solutions with a personalized touch. From these unassuming roots, we've experienced consistent growth, establishing a solid reputation for dependability and superior service in both residential and commercial projects.

Today, we steadfastly uphold the principles of honesty, excellence, and ensuring customer contentment, all of which Juan Ludueña ingrained from the very beginning. Proudly serving clients throughout Connecticut, we are committed to being a reliable ally for all their climate control requirements.

tabs.label: Mission
paragraphs: Provide comprehensive heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) solutions with the highest standards of quality and professionalism. We focus on optimizing the comfort of homes and the operational efficiency of businesses in Connecticut through specialized ductwork installations and cutting-edge residential systems.

tabs.label: Vision
paragraphs: Establish ourselves as the leading and most trusted HVAC contractor in Connecticut, recognized for our technical excellence, immediate responsiveness, and the implementation of innovative climate solutions that enhance the quality of life in our community.

items.question: Do you offer free estimates?
items.answer: Yes, we provide free, detailed on-site estimates for any residential or commercial project across Connecticut.

items.question: What areas in Connecticut do you serve?
items.answer: We cover a wide service area including Bridgeport, Fairfield, Westport, Trumbull, Shelton, Stratford, Milford, Stamford, and Greenwich.

items.question: Do you specialize in commercial work?
items.answer: Absolutely. We are experts in commercial ductwork design and installation, as well as high-capacity HVAC systems for businesses and industrial spaces.

items.question: Are you licensed?
items.answer: Absolutely, HVAC JJSE CORP is a fully licensed and insured contractor.

items.question: What are your hours?
items.answer: We are open Monday to Friday, from 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
